correctness.rationale: The PL orbit-barycenter correspondence has explicit inverse, and the standalone enumeration ranges over all chord orbits, conflicts, and independent faces of each of the 15 reflection conjugacy classes for 3<=n<=12. All integer boundary products vanish. Exact Smith normal forms have unit nonzero invariants; dodecagon side-axis \(f=(21,85,100,48,11,1)\), boundary ranks \((20,61,38,10,1)\), so \(\widetilde H_1\cong\mathbb Z^4\), \(\widetilde H_2\cong\mathbb Z\), others zero. n<12 tables have support in at most one degree. No inference beyond finite range.

value.rationale: The first mixed-degree fixed-space transition of Jonsson’s natural polygon noncrossing matching complex under a canonical axis is mathematically motivated. It separates degrees \(1\) and \(2\) in geometric fixed homology despite the ordinary dodecagon complex having homology only in degree \(3\); contrasts two axis types and identifies a sharp first size without inventing downstream applications.
